row.evidence: Tines' pricing and packaging article lists SCIM Provisioning in the Enterprise Tenant Management feature set, which is ticked only for the Enterprise Edition; the SCIM docs say SCIM support is not available in all plans.
row.notes: Free Community Edition (1 user) plus quote-only Business and Enterprise Editions; the public pricing page shows only 'Free edition' and 'Paid editions: Get pricing'. SSO (SAML/OIDC) is on all tenants including Community Edition; JIT is in Team Essentials (Business); SCIM, custom roles (RBAC) are in Enterprise Tenant Management (Enterprise only). SCIM DELETE disables the user; full deletion needs the UI or DELETE /api/v1/admin/users/{id}. Enabling SCIM disables UI/API invites and edits. Customers on pre-June-2025 packaging may differ.

plans.name: Community Edition
plans.notes: 1 user, 3 flows; Security Essentials is 'SSO only' (no audit logs).

plans.name: Business Edition
plans.notes: User limit 100; JIT provisioning via Team Essentials.

auth.token_source: Tenant owner API key (Tines connect flow)

operations.notes: Endpoint table lists GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on Users and Groups; DELETE on a user disables rather than deletes.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users can no longer access the tenant; their data stays until a Tenant Owner deletes them via the UI or the admin users API.

roles.how: userType attribute (TENANT_OWNER or USER) for tenant owner; or IdP group to team/role/tenant-permission mapping (scim_user_group_mapping), applied on each SCIM operation.

limitations.text: With SCIM enabled, UI and API invites and user edits are disabled; users are managed only by the IdP.
SCIM is not compatible with just-in-time provisioning.
userName must be the user's email.
The user's groups attribute is immutable; membership changes go through each Group's members.
SCIM DELETE disables the user; full deletion requires the UI or the admin users API.

auth.notes: Admin users API needs a tenant owner key; USER_READ/USER_MANAGE tenant permissions do not grant /admin/users access.

endpoints.purpose: Sign user out on all devices
Invite user to team with role
Update SCIM IdP group to team/role mapping

rate_limits.text: Most APIs 5000 per minute; admin/users 500 and audit_logs 1000 (per IP and API token).

limitations.text: Only tenant owners can completely remove a user from a tenant.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, OIDC, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Schema Discovery.

fallbacks.other_sync: Enhanced just-in-time syncing updates team and role assignments from IdP groups on every login (Business Edition and up).
